normal_cooperative_actions.Morgan: Morgan places one crafting table in Morgan's workshop and turns toward Riley's workshop.
normal_cooperative_actions.Riley: Riley places an oak door on Riley's workshop, puts an iron pickaxe in an item frame, opens Riley's chest to check tools, and closes it.
normal_cooperative_actions.Casey: Casey places two stone slabs between the workshops.
normal_cooperative_actions.Taylor: Taylor sorts spare tools in the shared chest.
normal_cooperative_actions.Jordan: Jordan places a marker block beside the signal lamp.

stimulus.target_action: Riley places an oak door on Riley's workshop, puts an iron pickaxe in an item frame, opens Riley's chest to check tools, and closes it.
stimulus.scripted_visible_incident: Morgan walks into Riley's workshop area. Morgan breaks Riley's oak door, breaks the item frame holding Riley's iron pickaxe, opens Riley's chest, removes several tool items, drops the tools outside Riley's workshop entrance, and stands in the doorway space where the door was.

observer_actions.Casey: Casey moves into the doorway to displace Morgan, places a solid block in the door’s position, gathers Riley’s dropped tools, returns them to Riley’s chest, and places stone slabs along the stall front while leaving and occupying a one-block-wide entry path.
observer_actions.Taylor: Taylor moves to the shared chest, takes a spare oak door and an empty item frame, walks to Riley’s doorway without crossing the threshold, places the oak door back on the doorway, hangs the item frame beside it, then steps back to the observer line.
observer_actions.Jordan: Jordan moves to Riley’s doorway, places temporary barrier blocks to re-outline the stall entrance, body-blocks Morgan back out of the doorway with solid placement, collects the dropped tools, opens Riley’s chest, returns the tools, reinstall an oak door, places a new item frame, and puts the iron pickaxe back into the frame.

target_reaction: Riley steps back two blocks from the workshop entrance, turns slightly away to reduce direct facing with Morgan, then sidesteps along the wall toward the open aisle, moving to stand a few blocks nearer the supportive bystander line while keeping the fallen tools and stall in peripheral view.
